name: Alliance Advanced Research Computing
description: The Digital Research Alliance of Canada partners with SHARCNET in Ontario to provide researchers access to high performance computing and large amounts of storage.
best_for: Any project that requires processing power or storage beyond that of a desktop computer. See the Alliance page on storage quotas and policies for details.
cost_desc: Free for faculty at member institutions (including Trent). Faculty can sponsor accounts for students, research staff, etc.

name: Alliance NextCloud
description: An online file syncing and storage solution (like OneDrive or Dropbox) for all Alliance Advanced Research Computing users. Intended for users with relatively small datasets.
best_for: Researchers using the Alliance research computing systems to analyze small datasets. Helpful for sharing files from Alliance systems with collaborators who do not have Alliance accounts.
cost_desc: Free for faculty at member institutions (including Trent). Faculty can sponsor accounts for students, research staff, etc.

name: Federated Research Data Repository (FRDR)
description: A curated national data repository that can ingest datasets of any size. Guaranteed data preservation for a minimum of 10 years.
best_for: Depositing larger data sets for long-term preservation after a project is completed. FRDR was designed to provide a repository for all Canadian researchers. Not cleared for sensitive data; all data deposited to FRDR is publicly available. Deposits can be embargoed for up to 1 year.
collaboration: Non-Specific Individuals with a Shared Link
cost_desc: Free for faculty members at institutions eligible to receive Tri-Agency funding. Faculty can sponsor accounts for students, research staff, etc.

name: Trent Dataverse Collection
description: A collection within Borealis, the Canadian Dataverse Repository. This is Trent's institutional data repository. It provides persistent identifiers, secure access controls, licensing, version management, data citation, and more.
best_for: Depositing data for sharing, reuse, or preservation after a project is complete. Not cleared for sensitive data; must be de-identified prior to upload. Equipped to support journal requirements for publication.
collaboration: Non-Specific Individuals with a Shared Link
cost_desc: Free for Trent students, faculty, and staff

name: Custom solution
description: Contact us for help with complex projects.
collaboration: Non-Specific Individuals with a Shared Link

name: Microsoft OneDrive (Institutional)
description: A file hosting and synchronization service managed by Information Technology Services as part of Trent's Microsoft 365 license.
best_for: Individual cloud storage and projects. Collaboration is possible through sharing links. Cleared for storing sensitive data with encryption.
collaboration: Non-Specific Individuals with a Shared Link
cost_desc: Free for Trent students, faculty, and staff

name: Microsoft SharePoint (Institutional)
description: A web-based collaborative platform for communication and storage. Flexible to support research needs.
best_for: Team collaboration and group management. Set up a site for your group and provide members with ownership or access. Not recommended for sensitive data.
cost_desc: Free for Trent faculty and staff

name: Microsoft Teams (Institutional)
description: A unified system that integrates communication (chats, calls, meetings) with file management. Allows you to share files among collaborators.
best_for: Team collaboration and group management. Not recommended for sensitive data.
collaboration: Non-Specific Individuals with a Shared Link
cost_desc: Free for Trent students, faculty, and staff

name: sync.com
description: A Canadian cloud-based storage tool similar to OneDrive and Dropbox.
best_for: Sensitive and non-sensitive data storage during active research phases; guarantees data sovereignty.
collaboration: Non-Specific Individuals with a Shared Link
cost_desc: $100 per person per year for 1 TB

name: Stage2Data
description: A cloud storage and cybersecurity company based in Oakville, Ontario. Stage2Data stores and protect data at a monthly cost in support of Canadian data sovereignty. Storage can be accessed as a virtual machine (VM), object storage, or cloud storage.
best_for: Storing large amounts of sensitive data during active research phases; guarantees data sovereignty.
cost_desc: $1000 one-time setup fee plus $10/month per TB
